title: Dinner Lady Tobacco Virginia 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dinner Lady’s Bar Salts Virginia Tobacco delivers a rich yet delicately balanced take on a timeless tobacco blend. The mildly sweet and grassy character of Virginia Tobacco is elevated by subtle citrus and hay notes, while undertones of toasted Almond and Oak lend a warm, earthy depth. A final touch of smooth Vanilla rounds out the profile, creating a layered and refined tobacco experience. Part of the Bar Salts collection, Virginia Tobacco is designed to replicate the full-bodied and authentic flavours often found in disposable vapes. Using a double-concentrated Nic Salt formula, this e-liquid ensures a long-lasting, satisfying vape while delivering a consistently smooth inhale. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid provides an excellent balance of vapour production and rich flavour, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The nicotine salt formulation offers a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction, making it best suited for pod kits and classic vape starter devices. Since 2016, Dinner Lady has been crafting premium e-liquids that are now enjoyed in over 80 countries worldwide. Their dedication to high-quality ingredients and expertly developed blends continues to make them a trusted choice for vapers.
